name: transfer-list
purpose: Moves items between two lists, Available and Selected, such as team members, permissions, or report columns. Each list is a WAI-ARIA multi-select listbox with a search box and an item count; buttons move the checked or all visible items, Enter and double-click move too, and pointer drag between the lists is optional. Long lists are windowed. A Form control with one hidden input per selected value.
whenToUse: Choosing a subset from a long list where users benefit from seeing both what is chosen and what is left: team assignment, permissions, report columns.
Selections of tens to thousands of items that need search on both sides.
whenNotToUse: A few options: use Checkbox Group.
Picking several items inline in a form row: use Multi Select.
Ordering items: use Sortable List (the Selected list keeps the order of moves, but cannot be reordered).
responsive: Two lists with the buttons between them; containers narrower than 30rem stack the lists and turn the buttons a quarter (container query). The lists show visibleRows rows (default 8) and scroll.
rtl: The Available list is on the right, the arrows on the move buttons are mirrored, and text aligns to the right.
theme: Global tokens only: surfaces, borders, selection colors, and the focus ring; checked options use color-selected and a filled check box. Forced colors use Highlight and HighlightText for checked options and CanvasText for the active option.
security: Labels and descriptions are rendered with textContent. Window positions are set through the CSSOM (CSP-safe, no style attributes).
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. Search runs over the items in memory.

budgets.budget: < 50 ms in headless Chromium (only the visible rows are rendered)
< 4 ms for 8 visible rows plus 12 overscan rows

performance.testedScale: 10,000 items per list. Rows have one fixed height (control-height-sm); descriptions are truncated to one line.

limitations: Rows have a fixed height so the window can be computed; long labels and descriptions are truncated with an ellipsis.
Values not found in items are dropped from the value.
The Selected list cannot be reordered.
unsupported: Server-side search or paging; supply the items in memory (10,000 tested).
antiPatterns: Using it for two or three options.
Hiding the search box on long lists.
